implementation.elm_bridge: TimelineSurface action -> App::handle_actions -> BackendBridge -> Shell::update(Message) -> disposable projection -> redraw
implementation.stage_frame_source: Document -> StoreView -> Engine -> re_renderer CPU RGBA readback
implementation.async_boundary: current timeline messages are synchronous; Iced Task and Subscription require a dedicated runtime bridge before broader feature delegation

line_grammar.coordinate_lines: Timeline minor and major time grid only

timeline_geometry.clip_vertical_rule: lane_top with lane_height minus one separator pixel
timeline_geometry.rail_control_alignment: each MSL cell centered in x and y
timeline_geometry.ruler_tick_rule: motolii_timeline_pane::tick_steps_with_target recalculated from horizontal visible frame span

timeline_interaction_contract.playhead_drag: Scrub(frame) -> Shell::update(Message::ScrubTo) -> Session.playhead -> frame_rgba and TimelineModel
timeline_interaction_contract.lane_drag: Restack(layer,target_from_front) -> Select(layer) -> RestackLayer(ToIndexFromBack) -> Intent::SetOrder apply_all -> Stage and lane projection
timeline_interaction_contract.zoom: TimelineSurface horizontal viewport only; no Document write and no y scale
timeline_interaction_contract.zoom_ruler: minor and major ticks recomputed after every viewport change
timeline_interaction_contract.gesture_seam: platform transform facts -> gesture_input adapter -> consumer policy
timeline_interaction_contract.trackpad_zoom: option plus scroll fallback; macOS native scale gesture
timeline_interaction_contract.trackpad_phase: axis and verb locked across Began Changed Ended Momentum; Touched catches momentum
timeline_interaction_contract.delta_policy: precise phased deltas preserved; phase-less wheel deltas normalized to 120-unit notches

evidence.acceptance: cargo run --locked --manifest-path next/probes/r7-makepad-panel/Cargo.toml opens the panel and editing panel.splash reloads it
